decisions.description: A verdict per palette the reviewer decided. At most one favourite.

action.description: favorite: the one to take forward. keep: still on the shortlist. drop: set it aside.

note.description: On the palette as a whole: what to change, or why it goes.

comments.description: Remarks pinned to one token of the palette.

token.description: The token's name, as the payload gave it.

role.description: The role the token plays, when it has one.

mode.description: The theme the reviewer was looking at: light, dark, or both for a token with one value.

where.description: The part of the sample screen the comment was made on, e.g. Primary button.

edits.description: New values the reviewer set for tokens, to apply as they are: one per token and theme.

token.description: The token's name, as the payload gave it.

mode.description: Which value to replace: light, dark, or both for a token sent with one value.

from.description: The value as the payload sent it.

to.description: The new value, as #rrggbb unless the reviewer typed another CSS colour.
